notes: GST is 3% on jewelry (CBIC FAQ: on total value incl. making charge) and on bars/coins. Import duty reported raised to 15% (BCD 10% + AIDC 5%) by a May 2026 notification (Angel One). IBJA benchmark (24K 10 g) excludes GST and making charges. Making charges vary by design and brand; banks usually give no bar buyback. No sourced premium values.

sources.name: GST Council/CBIC FAQ on gems and jewellery
sources.what: Official FAQ: 3% GST on total transaction value of jewellery, 3% IGST on imports of precious metals

sources.name: Angel One - GST on gold
sources.what: 3% GST on bars and coins; import duty 15% after May 2026 notification (older text says about 6.5%)
